headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 10, 2026**
article:
The day's top news saw the Washington Nationals dominate the Cincinnati Reds 7-1, with Abimelec Ortiz leading the Reds' offense. In other action, the Athletics edged the Red Sox 4-3 behind Eli White's 3-hit performance, while the Mets cruised past the Pirates 11-1 behind Sean Manaea's strong outing. The Phillies secured a thrilling 7-6 victory over the Blue Jays, with Caleb Kilian earning the win.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, including Griffin Jax, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Tampa Bay Rays due to right elbow discomfort. Other players affected by injuries include Cooper Pratt, Jack Leiter, Ben Williamson, Cole Wilcox, Joe Ryan, Slade Cecconi, and Chris Murphy.

The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their roster with the addition of first baseman Jacob Berry, acquired in a trade. The Athletics also made a trade, acquiring right-hander Seth Johnson from the Phillies in exchange for outfielder Colby Thomas. The Marlins traded right-hander Lake Bachar to the Pirates for a package of players, while the Rockies traded right-hander Victor Vodnik to the Marlins for infielder Connor Norby and right-hander Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall to Nationals in Dominant 7-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds suffered a tough defeat at the hands of the Washington Nationals, who won 7-1. Abimelec Ortiz led the Reds' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Athletics Edge Red Sox in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Athletics secured a narrow win over the Boston Red Sox, finishing with a final score of 4-3. Eli White led the Athletics' offense with a 3-hit performance.

top_news.title: **Mets Cruise Past Pirates 11-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates, securing an 11-1 victory. Sean Manaea led the way for the Mets, pitching 7.0 innings with 11 strikeouts and just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Phillies Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a 7-6 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Caleb Kilian earning the win. Kyle Schwarber led the Phillies' offense with two home runs and four RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays RHP Griffin Jax Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays right-hander Griffin Jax has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort, effective retroactive to August 6, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their roster with the addition of first baseman Jacob Berry, who was traded to the team. Berry joins the Royals after being acquired in a trade.
